# SurrogateGradientAsymmetry

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The deliberate use of non-symmetric gradient shapes (e.g., different slopes for positive vs. negative errors) to improve convergence in spiking networks. Improves training accuracy and speed for SNNs, which is essential for real-time, low-latency inference in iNEST-enabled network devices.
